verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a code-first library with no required dashboard ("No dashboard clicks. Your auth lives in code"). It offers server-side `auth.api` methods callable without a browser, and an official CLI (`npx auth init`, schema generation and migrations) that community users confirm works for one-command setup and migrations, all of which suit scripted or automated use. However, nothing documents CI or headless automation explicitly, and one hands-on user reports that its request-header-based design made admin scripts and tests "very hacky" because plugins wouldn't run otherwise. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation documentation, non-interactive CLI flags/usage for pipelines, a clean documented path for running admin scripts and tests without request-header workarounds, independent corroboration of CI usage.
